not_expressed.closed_loop: compute_ns is a clock64 spin, written as issue work at the CTA's alone rate; with more than one CTA per SM the model would share that issue work and the spin does not, so those points (compute_ns > 0 and more CTAs than SMs) are left out
not_expressed.miss_merging: stagger_stages 16 delays the followers' start once; KernelIR has no per-CTA start offset, so only stagger 0 is checked (the basis in design.md)
not_expressed.dependent_chain: instruction counts from the CUDA source, not SASS: per warp per step 2 x mma_per_half MMAs, softmax_ops / 2 ex2, 4 shuffles, softmax_ops + 15 other
not_expressed.pipes: sfu and shfl rates are the profile's own curves (their check is leave-one-out interpolation, not a core run) and are not re-run here
not_expressed.cross_wave_reuse: its microbenchmarks are not in the profile
not_expressed.address_arithmetic: loop and address instructions are not counted in any kernel
